  # Exploratory sample (phase 2.2): 506 participants, 5 tools, rare options collapsed (<= 2.5%)
  data_file: "phase2-1-scale-development/data/prepared/ratings-stimulus_collapsed.csv"

Suggestion of Anne-Flore (2026-11-04): fit the same CFA structures on the **exploratory
sample** (the sample used for the EFA and the item reduction), not only on the
confirmatory one, to see how stable the 3- and 4-factor structures are across samples.

**Same specification as step 06** (`06_alternative-structures.Rmd`): the same 11 structures,
ML (lavaan default), `missing = "fiml"`, collapsed data; pooled, unconstrained multi-group by
tool, and each tool alone. Only the data change.

Points to keep in mind when reading the results:

* The 13 items of `3_Factor_A` were **selected on this sample** (step 05 of phase 2.2), so
  its fit here is optimistic. `4_Factor_C` was derived from the EFA of the **validation**
  sample. Each structure is therefore "out of sample" in a different dataset.
* The tools differ: Gephi, Power BI, Qlik, Tableau, JMP here; Tableau, JMP, Excel,
  Data Studio, Power BI in validation.
* The exploratory data use a −3 … +3 scale and validation 1 … 7. A shift of the scale does
  not change the fit, loadings, α or ω.
* The rare options were collapsed with the same rule as validation (≤ 2.5%, merged into the
  neighbour with more answers), item by item, so it does not matter that the exploratory file
  was collapsed with all 65 items present.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lavaan)
library(semTools)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)

phase_dir  <- here("phase3-validation")
output_dir <- file.path(phase_dir, "07_exploratory-sample-cfa", "output")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Data

Item codes of the exploratory file are renamed with the short names of the validation
codebook, so the model definitions are the same as in step 06.

```{r data}
data_path <- here(params$data_file)
stopifnot(file.exists(data_path))
raw <- read.csv(data_path, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")

codebook <- read.csv(file.path(phase_dir, "data", "codebook", "items.csv"))
missing_items <- setdiff(codebook$code, names(raw))
if (length(missing_items) > 0) stop("Items not in the exploratory data: ", paste(missing_items, collapse = ", "))

grp_data <- raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(stimulus) & stimulus != "") %>%
  select(seed, stimulus, all_of(codebook$code))
names(grp_data)[match(codebook$code, names(grp_data))] <- codebook$short_name
grp_data$stimulus <- factor(grp_data$stimulus)

stimuli_letters <- levels(grp_data$stimulus)
cat("N =", nrow(grp_data), "\n"); print(table(grp_data$stimulus))

# Missing answers per item (FIML uses all available answers)
kable(data.frame(item = codebook$short_name, code = codebook$code,
                 n_missing = colSums(is.na(grp_data[codebook$short_name]))),
      row.names = FALSE, caption = "Missing answers per item")

writeLines(c(paste("data_file:", data_path),
             paste("md5:", tools::md5sum(data_path)),
             paste("run at:", Sys.time())),
           file.path(output_dir, "run_info.txt"))
```

## 3. Functions (as in step 06, plus admissibility)

```{r functions}
# Fit one CFA and keep the warnings (e.g. a non positive definite latent matrix)
fit_cfa <- function(syntax, data, group = NULL) {
  warns <- character(0)
  fit <- tryCatch(withCallingHandlers(
    lavaan::cfa(model = syntax, data = data, group = group, missing = "fiml"),
    warning = function(w) { warns <<- c(warns, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") }),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit)) attr(fit, "warnings") <- unique(warns)
  fit
}

ok_fit <- function(fit) !is.null(fit) && is(fit, "lavaan") && lavInspect(fit, "converged")

fit_indices <- c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "cfi", "tli", "rmsea",
                 "rmsea.ci.lower", "rmsea.ci.upper", "srmr", "aic", "bic")

extract_fit_measures <- function(fit, label) {
  res <- data.frame(Model = label, t(setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(fit_indices)), fit_indices)),
                    admissible = NA, warnings = NA_character_)
  if (!ok_fit(fit)) return(res)
  fm <- fitMeasures(fit, fit_indices)
  res[fit_indices] <- as.numeric(fm[fit_indices])
  # post.check: FALSE when there are negative variances or a latent correlation matrix that is
  # not positive definite (e.g. a latent correlation > 1)
  res$admissible <- suppressWarnings(lavInspect(fit, "post.check"))
  res$warnings <- gsub("\\s+", " ", paste(attr(fit, "warnings"), collapse = " | "))
  res
}

extract_reliability <- function(fit, label) {
  if (!ok_fit(fit)) return(NULL)
  rel <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(semTools::reliability(fit)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(rel)) return(NULL)
  d <- as.data.frame(t(rel)); d$Factor <- rownames(d); d$Model <- label
  if ("avevar" %in% names(d)) d$ave <- d$avevar
  d <- d[, intersect(c("Model", "Factor", "alpha", "omega", "ave"), names(d))]
  d[sapply(d, is.numeric)] <- round(d[sapply(d, is.numeric)], 4)
  rownames(d) <- NULL
  d
}

extract_cfa_loadings <- function(fit, label) {
  if (!ok_fit(fit)) return(NULL)
  standardizedSolution(fit) %>%
    filter(op == "=~") %>%
    transmute(Model = label, Factor = lhs, Item = rhs,
              Std_all = round(est.std, 4), R_Squared = round(est.std^2, 4),
              SE = round(se, 4), P_Value = round(pvalue, 4))
}

extract_latent_correlations <- function(fit, label) {
  if (!ok_fit(fit)) return(NULL)
  cm <- lavInspect(fit, "cor.lv")
  if (is.list(cm)) return(NULL)            # multi-group: not used here
  if (length(cm) <= 1) return(NULL)
  idx <- which(upper.tri(cm), arr.ind = TRUE)
  data.frame(Model = label, Factor1 = rownames(cm)[idx[, 1]], Factor2 = colnames(cm)[idx[, 2]],
             Correlation = round(cm[idx], 4))
}
```

## 4. CFA on the exploratory sample

```{r cfa}
pooled_fit <- pooled_rel <- pooled_load <- pooled_cor <- list()
mg_fit <- list()
ind_fit <- ind_rel <- ind_load <- ind_cor <- list()

for (m in names(cfa_models_list)) {
  syn <- cfa_models_list[[m]]

  # 4.1 Pooled
  f <- fit_cfa(syn, grp_data)
  lab <- paste0("Pooled_", m)
  pooled_fit[[m]]  <- extract_fit_measures(f, lab)
  pooled_rel[[m]]  <- extract_reliability(f, lab)
  pooled_load[[m]] <- extract_cfa_loadings(f, lab)
  pooled_cor[[m]]  <- extract_latent_correlations(f, lab)

  # 4.2 Unconstrained multi-group by tool
  f <- fit_cfa(syn, grp_data, group = "stimulus")
  mg_fit[[m]] <- extract_fit_measures(f, paste0("Multigroup_", m))

  # 4.3 Each tool alone
  for (s in stimuli_letters) {
    f <- fit_cfa(syn, droplevels(filter(grp_data, stimulus == s)))
    lab <- paste0(s, "_", m)
    ind_fit[[lab]]  <- extract_fit_measures(f, lab)
    ind_rel[[lab]]  <- extract_reliability(f, lab)
    ind_load[[lab]] <- extract_cfa_loadings(f, lab)
    ind_cor[[lab]]  <- extract_latent_correlations(f, lab)
  }
  cat("done:", m, "\n")
}

pooled_fit  <- bind_rows(pooled_fit);  pooled_rel <- bind_rows(pooled_rel)
pooled_load <- bind_rows(pooled_load); pooled_cor <- bind_rows(pooled_cor)
mg_fit      <- bind_rows(mg_fit)
ind_fit     <- bind_rows(ind_fit);     ind_rel    <- bind_rows(ind_rel)
ind_load    <- bind_rows(ind_load);    ind_cor    <- bind_rows(ind_cor)

wb <- createWorkbook()
for (sh in list(list("Pooled_Fit", pooled_fit), list("Pooled_Reliability_AVE", pooled_rel),
                list("Pooled_CFA_Loadings", pooled_load), list("Pooled_Latent_Correlations", pooled_cor),
                list("Multigroup_Fit", mg_fit), list("By_Stimulus_Fit", ind_fit),
                list("By_Stimulus_Reliability", ind_rel), list("By_Stimulus_CFA_Loadings", ind_load),
                list("By_Stimulus_Latent_Corr", ind_cor))) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sh[[1]]); writeData(wb, sh[[1]], sh[[2]])
}
saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(output_dir, "CFA_Model_Fit_Exploratory.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)

show_cols <- c("Model", "chisq", "df", "cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr", "bic", "admissible")
kable(pooled_fit[, show_cols], digits = 3, caption = "Exploratory sample, pooled")
kable(mg_fit[, show_cols], digits = 3, caption = "Exploratory sample, multi-group by tool")
```

### Fit rule and admissibility

Fit rule of the project: (CFI or TLI ≥ 0.95) and (SRMR ≤ 0.08 or RMSEA ≤ 0.06).
Models with warnings (e.g. a latent correlation above 1):

```{r warnings}
bind_rows(pooled_fit, mg_fit) %>%
  mutate(meets_rule = (cfi >= .95 | tli >= .95) & (srmr <= .08 | rmsea <= .06)) %>%
  select(Model, meets_rule, admissible, warnings) %>%
  kable()
```

### 3_Factor_A and 4_Factor_C: reliability and latent correlations (pooled)

```{r focus}
focus <- c("Pooled_3_Factor_A", "Pooled_4_Factor_C")
kable(filter(pooled_rel, Model %in% focus), caption = "alpha, omega, AVE")
kable(filter(pooled_cor, Model %in% focus), caption = "Latent correlations")
kable(filter(ind_cor, grepl("_4_Factor_C$", Model), Factor1 == "visual_interaction", Factor2 == "effectiveness"),
      caption = "4_Factor_C: visual_interaction with effectiveness, by tool")
```

## 5. Exploratory vs. validation sample

```{r comparison}
val_path <- here(params$validation_file)
if (file.exists(val_path)) {
  read_val <- function(sheet) read.xlsx(val_path, sheet = sheet)
  strip <- function(x, prefix) sub(paste0("^", prefix, "_"), "", x)
  cols <- c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr", "bic")

  side_by_side <- function(expl, val, prefix) {
    e <- expl %>% mutate(Structure = strip(Model, prefix)) %>% select(Structure, all_of(cols))
    v <- val  %>% mutate(Structure = strip(Model, prefix)) %>% select(Structure, all_of(cols))
    full_join(e, v, by = "Structure", suffix = c("_expl", "_valid")) %>%
      mutate(cfi_change = cfi_valid - cfi_expl, rmsea_change = rmsea_valid - rmsea_expl) %>%
      select(Structure, cfi_expl, cfi_valid, cfi_change, tli_expl, tli_valid,
             rmsea_expl, rmsea_valid, rmsea_change, srmr_expl, srmr_valid) %>%
      arrange(Structure)
  }

  cmp_pooled <- side_by_side(pooled_fit, read_val("Pooled_Fit"), "Pooled")
  cmp_mg     <- side_by_side(mg_fit, read_val("Multigroup_Fit"), "Multigroup")

  rel_val <- read_val("Pooled_Reliability_AVE")
  cmp_rel <- full_join(
    pooled_rel %>% mutate(Structure = strip(Model, "Pooled")) %>% select(-Model),
    rel_val    %>% mutate(Structure = strip(Model, "Pooled")) %>% select(-Model),
    by = c("Structure", "Factor"), suffix = c("_expl", "_valid")) %>%
    filter(Structure %in% c("3_Factor_A", "4_Factor_C")) %>%
    select(Structure, Factor, alpha_expl, alpha_valid, omega_expl, omega_valid, ave_expl, ave_valid)

  wb2 <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb2, "Pooled_Fit"); writeData(wb2, "Pooled_Fit", cmp_pooled)
  addWorksheet(wb2, "Multigroup_Fit"); writeData(wb2, "Multigroup_Fit", cmp_mg)
  addWorksheet(wb2, "Reliability_3A_4C"); writeData(wb2, "Reliability_3A_4C", cmp_rel)
  saveWorkbook(wb2, file.path(output_dir, "Comparison_Exploratory_vs_Validation.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)

  print(kable(cmp_pooled, digits = 3, caption = "Pooled: exploratory vs. validation"))
  print(kable(cmp_mg, digits = 3, caption = "Multi-group: exploratory vs. validation"))
  print(kable(cmp_rel, digits = 3, caption = "3_Factor_A and 4_Factor_C: reliability"))
} else {
  cat("Validation workbook not found; run step 06 first:", val_path, "\n")
}
```
